<div class="card-body">
'''Advosze''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊＊＊アドヴォーズ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">アドヴォーズと同じロケーションに手札から武器を配備する場合、「反動」によって即座に1フォースを起動する。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。1つの位置、あるいは1つの宇宙船には、1人のアドヴォーズしか存在できない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Advosze-PSA-160005368.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アドヴォーズの男性にはありがちなことだが、ボム・ヴィムディンは同族を嫌っている。ペシミストで縄張り意識が強い。一匹狼の密輸屋で、腐敗した官僚たちが得意先。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Advosze.

'''Card text:'''
When you deploy a weapon from hand at the same location as an Advosze, immediately activate 1 Force as a “kickback.” Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. Only one Advosze may be at a location or aboard a starship.

'''Lore:'''
As is common among male Advosze, Bom Vimdin dislikes his own kind. A pessimist with a strong sense of territory. A lone-wolf smuggler whose best customers are corrupt officials.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese kickback is when you deploy a weapon from hand; the English is a weapon or device.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Advosze]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
